title: ajax luteus
intro: Ajax luteus, commonly known as Lomatium, is a flowering plant native to the western United States and Canada. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Lomatium include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lomatium include sesquiterpenes and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as expectorant and antispasmodic effects, and its ability to stimulate the immune system.
